summary.headline: Advanced Enzyme Q1 FY27 revenue rose 2% YoY to INR 1,898 million, but EBITDA fell 10% to INR 510 million as margin dropped to 27%.
summary.overview:
Consolidated revenue of INR 1,898 million grew 2% YoY but fell 7% QoQ, held back by an extra INR 100 million sales reversal for export shipments still in transit. EBITDA declined 10% YoY and 19% QoQ to INR 510 million, with margin at 27% versus 30% a year ago, attributed to lower realisation, higher power and fuel costs, and a sales-mix shift. PAT was INR 386 million, down 5% YoY. Management guided to a return to about 30-32% EBITDA margin, double-digit growth for the rest of the year, and announced a INR 697 million buyback and full acquisition of JC Biotech.</overview>
